tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Totals for a Playwright JSON report: total, passed, failed, flaky, skipped and run duration in milliseconds.

reportPath.description: Path to a Playwright JSON report (.json). Absolute, or relative to PW_REPORT_DIR / the server's working directory.

tools.name: list_failures
tools.description: Failed tests in a Playwright JSON report: full name, title, project and a trimmed error message for each.

reportPath.description: Path to a Playwright JSON report (.json). Absolute, or relative to PW_REPORT_DIR / the server's working directory.

includeFlaky.description: Also list tests that failed and then passed on retry

maxErrorChars.description: Maximum characters of each error message

tools.name: slowest_test
tools.description: The N slowest tests in a Playwright JSON report, with their execution times in milliseconds.

reportPath.description: Path to a Playwright JSON report (.json). Absolute, or relative to PW_REPORT_DIR / the server's working directory.

tools.name: compare_reports
tools.description: Compare two Playwright JSON reports (baseline vs current): newly failed, newly passed, still failing, added and removed tests, plus per-test execution time changes.

baselinePath.description: Path to the baseline (earlier) Playwright JSON report

currentPath.description: Path to the current (later) Playwright JSON report

minDurationDeltaMs.description: Only report execution time changes of at least this many milliseconds

limit.description: Maximum execution time changes to return

maxErrorChars.description: Maximum characters of each error message

tools.name: get_execution_times
tools.description: Execution time in milliseconds of every test in a Playwright JSON report.

reportPath.description: Path to a Playwright JSON report (.json). Absolute, or relative to PW_REPORT_DIR / the server's working directory.

sort.description: Ordering of the tests; 'report' keeps the order of the report file

tools.name: get_test_details
tools.description: Everything the report holds about one test, looked up by name: status, location, every attempt with its error, code snippet and attachments.

reportPath.description: Path to a Playwright JSON report (.json). Absolute, or relative to PW_REPORT_DIR / the server's working directory.

name.description: Test title or full name ('file › describe › title'); a case-insensitive fragment also matches

project.description: Restrict the lookup to one Playwright project, e.g. chromium
